title: Homotopy-pullback pasting criterion for spaces
statement:
Use spaces as defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the path-space homotopy-pullback notion in [lem-coef-infinity-cocartesian-mapping-criterion]. For maps $r:X\to Z$ and $s:Y\to Z$, the path homotopy pullback is $X\times_{Z,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Z)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,Z}Y$, with all products and pullbacks formed degreewise; a specified commutation homotopy supplies the path coordinate of the comparison map. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccccc}A&\longrightarrow&C&\longrightarrow&D\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow&&\downarrow\\
A'&\longrightarrow&C'&\longrightarrow&D'\end{array}$$
be a diagram of spaces with commuting adjacent squares. If the right square is a homotopy pullback, then the left square is a homotopy pullback if and only if the outer rectangle is a homotopy pullback. In particular two adjacent homotopy-pullback squares paste to a homotopy pullback. The assertion also applies to specified homotopy-commuting squares: their comparison maps to the path pullbacks use the specified commutation homotopies, and the outer rectangle uses the concatenated homotopy.
